1–2 hours (if you already have the items) + 2 h waiting for the helmet

The {wiki:Knight Outfits|Knight Outfit} can be used by any player; this quest gives both addons. The sword is forged by {npc:Morgan}, in Sabrehaven, in exchange for iron ore. The ornate helmet is awarded by {npc:Gregor}, leader of the knights' guild in Thais, after you prove your worth with four tasks; {npc:Sam} finishes the helmet. You also earn the achievement **In Shining Armor**.
If you spend your time fighting monsters and need some extra protection, this well-armoured outfit is great for you. The addons are usually awarded by knights' guilds.
No minimum level (60+ recommended for going to the final room of Banuta).
You must talk to Gregor about the helmet **before** going to Banuta, otherwise you cannot open the door.
To get to {npc:Morgan}: access to Meriana, given by the *Access to Meriana* mission of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|The Shattered Isles Quest}.
For Ramsay's helmet: access to {wiki:Deeper Banuta|Deeper Banuta}, given in the last mission of {wiki:The Ape City Quest|The Ape City Quest}.
To trade items with {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}: have completed {wiki:The Sweaty Cyclops Quest|The Sweaty Cyclops Quest}.

Gather all the items before talking to the NPCs (except the {item:Damaged Steel Helmet}, which you can only pick up after accepting Gregor's task).
Buying the items from other players is usually easier than hunting them.
Collect 100 {item:Iron Ore}: it drops from all kinds of {wiki:Dwarves|Dwarves} and from some {wiki:Geo-Elementals|Geo-Elementals}, such as {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}.
Trading the Giant Sword for Crude Iron

Go to **Ab'Dendriel** and trade a {item:Giant Sword} with {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} for a {item:Huge Chunk of Crude Iron}. He lives on the 4th floor of a tower **north-east** of the depot: enter the small {creature:Rotworm|Rotworm} cave beneath the wheat field east of the depot, cross it to the tower and climb to the top floor. To leave, take the same route in reverse.
A Sweaty Cyclops (4th floor of the tower)

Sabrehaven is the rebel camp on the island of Meriana. Go to **Liberty Bay** and, on the small peninsula **south-east** of the depot, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}: {key:hi}, {key:peg leg} and {key:yes} (50 gp).
Go to Sabrehaven and talk to {npc:Morgan}: {key:hi}, {key:weapons} (or {key:forge}) and choose {key:knights sword}.
With the 100 Iron Ore and the Huge Chunk of Crude Iron in your inventory, say {key:hi}, {key:forge weapon} and {key:knights sword}.
To go back to **Liberty Bay**, go to {npc:Sebastian}, **south** of Sabrehaven, and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} and {key:yes} (50 gp).
Talk to {npc:Gregor} in the Thais knights' guild: {key:hi}, {key:outfit}, {key:task}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}.
Collect 100 {item:Perfect Behemoth Fang|Perfect Behemoth Fangs}, by looting and/or {wiki:Skinning|skinning} {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}. Hand them in to Gregor: {key:behemoth fangs}, {key:yes}.
Getting to the final room of Banuta

Take a boat to **Port Hope** ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}) and cross the Tiquanda jungle **north-east** to Banuta. In {npc:Hairycles}'s temple (south-east of the town) go down **twice**; head **north** along the corridor to the hall full of apes, turn **west** and go down the stairs at the end. On floor -2 enter the marked {wiki:Magic Forcefield} to get to the first floor of Deeper Banuta. There break the **4** {item:Canopic Jar (Object)|Canopic Jars} and enter the **central** Magic Forcefield. On the next floor pull all **7 levers** to the **right** (the last one has to be the one next to the wall): the north wall disappears and you enter the statue room.
The Canopic Jars come back after a while and the levers are time-limited: go as a team.

The {item:Damaged Steel Helmet} (Ramsay the Reckless's helmet) is behind a sealed door in the final room of the {wiki:Banuta|Banuta} quest, the serpent god statue room in {wiki:Deeper Banuta|Deeper Banuta}: the helmet is in the **north** of that room.

If you have not talked to Gregor about the helmet beforehand, the door will not open. On the way to the last room of {wiki:The Ape City Quest|The Ape City Quest} there are {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}, {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns}, {creature:Hydra|Hydras} and more.

Leave through the portal at the start of the Deeper Banuta floor (if the wall comes back and you are on the inside, use the lever next to the wall to open it). The portal takes you to the **second floor of Banuta**; from there go up the stairs to the surface and walk back through the jungle **south-west** to Port Hope, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to **Thais** ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).
Go back to {npc:Gregor}: {key:Ramsay the Reckless Helmet}, {key:yes}.

Get a {item:Flask of Warrior's Sweat}: trade 4 {item:Warrior Helmet|Warrior Helmets} with the {wiki:Shopkeeper NPCs|Djinn shopkeepers} in the {wiki:Djinn|Djinn} towers ({npc:Haroun} in Ashta'daramai or {npc:Yaman} in Mal'ouquah, in the mountains near Ankrahmun; level 30 doors), or loot it from {creature:Undead Gladiator|Undead Gladiators}. Hand it in to Gregor: {key:warrior's sweat}, {key:yes}.

Get a {item:Piece of Royal Steel}: trade a {item:Crown Armor} with {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} in Ab'Dendriel (in the tower north-east of the depot, see the sword addon), or loot it from {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}. Hand it in to Gregor: {key:royal steel}, {key:yes}.
Asking Sam to adorn the helmet
Go to {npc:Sam}'s shop in Thais and say {key:adorned helmet}.
Wait **2 hours** and go back to {npc:Sam}: say {key:adorned helmet} again.
The base Knight Outfit can be chosen by any player; the quest only gives the addons.
